character_profile.persona_summary: A practical, health-conscious professional using a personal health dashboard assistant to remember screenshots, meals, and clinician follow-up over time. She uses the assistant to track day-to-day patterns without turning the task into diagnosis.
traits: often compares current choices with earlier screenshots
